expectations.text: Says this is a deviation from a critical limit requiring a corrective action (not merely a correction)
expectations.evidence: 'this calls for a corrective action. A simple correction is not enough'

expectations.text: Lists corrective action elements: identify and correct the problem, reduce likelihood of recurrence, evaluate affected food for safety, prevent adulterated food entering commerce, document it
expectations.evidence: Bottom line lists identify/correct, reduce recurrence, evaluate food, keep out of commerce, document

expectations.text: Defines a correction as a prompt action for a minor, isolated problem that does not directly affect product safety, with less documentation
expectations.evidence: Correction defined per 117.3; minor isolated problems not directly affecting safety; 'Document when appropriate'

expectations.text: States monitoring and corrective action records must be reviewed by (or under oversight of) a PCQI within 7 working days
expectations.evidence: 'Within 7 working days after the records are created'

expectations.text: States validation of process controls is required (within 90 days of production or before implementation) and mentions calibration of the thermometer
expectations.evidence: Validation within 90 calendar days; calibration/accuracy check of thermometer

expectations.text: States records must be kept at least 2 years, and mentions reanalysis if controls are found ineffective
expectations.evidence: 'Keep records for at least 2 years'; reanalysis when control proves ineffective
